intelligence.essence: Eligibility Uncertainty Preservation Law: NayaNET shall treat missing, contradictory, stale, or independently unverifiable eligibility records as unresolved evidence obligations. Unknown eligibility shall neither count as proven ineligibility nor independently establish a fairness violation. The system shall preserve every compatible execution history, initiate governed reconstruction, derive only conclusions supported across those histories, and independently verify any resulting change in fairness qualification. Reconstruction deadlines may require escalation but shall never manufacture proof, authority, or completion. The desired behavior: 'I cannot yet prove whether this scheduling opportunity was eligible. I will preserve both possibilities, recover the missing evidence, continue safe authorized investigation, and avoid declaring either a fairness violation or a clean result until the evidence supports it.' That is how NayaNET stays epistemically conservative without becoming operationally passive.
intelligence.falsifier: Missing evidence auto-converted to ineligible (hiding starvation) or to a violation (false accusation); a single debt number concealing disputed rounds; an unobserved service event ignored when it could have reset debt; a reconstruction deadline converting a gap into harmless ineligibility; uncertainty used as an indefinite escape hatch; a historical fairness-record gap failing closed on unrelated current actions — or treated as clearance; an overwritten gap receipt pretending uncertainty never existed.

human_view.meaning: Not knowing is not the same as either answer — and the system must never let it become one. Three verdicts, kept strictly apart: proven eligible (count it), proven ineligible (don't, keep the reason), and undetermined — with six named reasons for the third (missing record, contradictory records, stale record, incomplete sequence, untrusted assertion, unresolvable gap), each with its own reconstruction response. An evidence defect and an eligibility verdict are different things: a worker claiming ineligible while LAW proves eligible gets corrected to ELIGIBLE_PROVEN plus a separate integrity finding against the worker. When rounds are disputed, a single debt number lies — so the verifier reconstructs the debt across every history compatible with the evidence and reports the range: if every possible history breaches the bound, that's a breach; if none does, that's compliance; if some do and some don't, the verdict stays open. Two subtleties are nailed down: a possibly-unobserved service event during a gap could have reset the debt, so the reconstruction must reason over complete sequences, not summed booleans; and for interval claims the debt is the maximum over every prefix, so a later success can't erase an earlier breach. The worked example shows the power of this: two proven eligible rounds, one missing LAW record, bound of three — verdict UNDETERMINED, neither violation nor clean. Then round 104 arrives proven eligible and unserved: now every remaining history breaches, and the violation stands even if round 102 is never recovered. Missing evidence creates work, not a label: a reconstruction obligation with its own ID, owner, and fairness contract — because 'we can't prove starvation since the logs are missing, and we won't fix the logs since recovery is blocked' is a circle, not an answer. Contradictions get a precedence protocol from the canonical evidence hierarchy, never a vote. Six clocks track the gap so uncertainty can't become an escape hatch — and when the deadline passes, the system escalates with an explicit disposition instead of quietly filing the gap as harmless. Containment follows the real dependency closure: a historical fairness gap withholds only the dependent claim, while a disputed authority behind current LAW/ACT decisions fails closed — and an independently qualified scope stays untouched. Every gap gets a receipt that is appended to, never rewritten. Twelve adversarial tests, crowned by the U2/U3 pair: false ineligibility hiding three genuinely eligible rounds must be reconstructed into a proven breach, and the mirror — a worker crying 'eligible' where LAW was absent — must be refused.

Permanent contributions: the three-verdict × six-reason matrix (verdict and defect as separate dimensions), the D_min/D_max fairness-uncertainty assessment over compatible histories with the prefix-maximum rule and the service-reset reasoning, the worked 101–104 example (stronger surrounding evidence can resolve a disputed conclusion without recovering the missing record — and vice versa), reconstruction as an independent obligation with its own fairness contract (breaking the circular excuse), the source-precedence/conflict-resolution protocol, the six reconstruction clocks with the no-manufacture deadline discipline, the scope-specific containment rules, the append-only evidence-gap receipt, and the U1–U12 suite with the bidirectional U2/U3 mutation pair. Shawn's scoping stands: assessment at the verifier boundary + reconstruction obligation in progress machinery; the gap is a precise verification question. Make every gap an independent reconstruction obligation with its own fairness contract. Resolve contradictions by canonical precedence, never by vote. simple_view.meaning: Don't know isn't either answer — preserve both possibilities, reconstruct the evidence, and conclude only what every compatible history agrees on.
